statement: United States forces conduct at least one kinetic strike on Houthi targets inside Yemen between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-09, publicly confirmed by US Central Command or the Department of Defense.
resolution: TRUE if a CENTCOM or Department of Defense statement, press release, or official post confirms a US strike on Houthi targets in Yemen that occurred between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-09; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: US forces conduct no strike on Houthi targets in Yemen on any date from 2026-09-12 through 2026-10-09.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
